name: Heligoland (Schleswig-Holstein, Germany)
description: A horizontal tricolor of green, red and white.
history: The flag of Heligoland, the North Sea island municipality: 'Grün ist das Land, rot ist die Kant, weiß ist der Sand' — green the land, red the cliff, white the sand. Used under British rule (1807–1890) and official under Schleswig-Holstein today.
